evals.name: compose-diff-redacts-secrets
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment --diff staging prod

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. deploy/staging/compose.yaml and deploy/prod/compose.yaml are tracked. Production runs api at ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 with replicas 3. Staging runs api at ghcr.io/acme/api:1.0.0 with replicas 1. Both set PASSWORD to different values. No cloud credentials are used. The authoring-formats doc sets diagram_dialect.system to c4-plantuml. containers.json is absent.
evals.expected_output: collect-deployment.sh writes deployment.json from Compose only. render-deployment.sh writes deployment.md with one fenced plantuml block holding a Deployment_Node per environment, and a diff that names the image, the replica count, and that PASSWORD differs. Neither password appears.
expectations: Runs collect-deployment.sh and render-deployment.sh
Resolves the dialect with resolve-diagram-dialect.sh --kind system and passes --dialect c4-plantuml
Reports diagram_dialect.system, c4-plantuml, and the team convention doc path as the layer
Does not call a cloud API
The artifact names compose and the two environment files
The diff reports the image change and the replica change
The diff says the secret parameter differs and does not contain either password
Says map-containers output was not present

evals.name: terraform-remote-module-refuses

evals.name: kubernetes-and-compose-both-read
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment

Tracked files include deploy/compose.yaml and deploy/api.yaml, a Deployment plus an Ingress host api.example.com in namespace prod. The Ingress manifest also sets PASSWORD. The authoring-formats doc sets diagram_dialect.system to likec4.
evals.expected_output: Both compose and kubernetes are shipped tools. deployment.md contains one fenced likec4 block with a deployment environment, an instanceOf placement, and a deployment view. The password is absent. The ingress host is in the record.

deployment.md contains one fenced likec4 block with instanceOf and a deployment view

evals.name: kubernetes-namespace-diff
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-deployment --diff staging prod

Tracked files are deploy/staging.yaml and deploy/prod.yaml, Kubernetes Deployments for api in namespaces staging and prod. Prod runs ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0 with 3 replicas, container port 9090, LOG_LEVEL warn, and a FEATURE_X variable that staging lacks. Staging runs 1.0.0 with 1 replica, port 8080, LOG_LEVEL info. Each sets PASSWORD to a different value. Neither declares an Ingress.
evals.expected_output: The diff names the image, the replica count, the port, the LOG_LEVEL value, FEATURE_X as present in prod only, and that PASSWORD differs. It lists the difference kinds compared and says networks and Ingress hosts are not compared. Neither password appears.
expectations: The environments are the namespaces staging and prod
The diff reports the image, replica, port, and LOG_LEVEL differences
The diff reports FEATURE_X as present in one environment only
The diff says the secret parameter differs and does not contain either password
The diff section lists the kinds compared and does not claim networks or Ingress hosts were compared
